# Track Studio 1.2.9-rc.202611271019

## 中文

本轮重做设置窗口的导航、搜索与页面布局，设置项本身的语义和存储格式不变。

### 分类导航与搜索

- 设置窗口改为左侧分类导航、顶部搜索和右侧内容区，包含常用、常规、播放器、快捷键、音乐库、分析与指纹、集成与服务、高级与维护 8 个页面。
- 新增“常用”页：固定常用设置入口，并按最近修改时间保留 5 项；常用项可一键跳到对应设置。
- 搜索覆盖设置名称、说明和中英文别名，结果保留所属页面与分组，点击后直接定位并跳到目标卡片。

### 页面与视觉

- 所有设置页统一为两列卡片布局；单控件行统一为“标签左、控件右”，勾选框与单选圆点做光学居中。
- 统一页面标题、分组标题、卡片标签、说明、控件右缘与底部按钮的视觉列；搜索页、危险操作卡片和开发者维护卡片也回到同一网格。
- 修正长说明在窄列中的断词与异常换行，移出/删除歌单、试听缓存、精选表演者等说明按整行展示。
- 从常用页或搜索结果跳转后，目标卡片使用系统现有的 `flashing-border` 闪烁效果（0.5 秒一次、连续 3 次，1.5 秒后自动停止），不再使用静态蓝色填充。

### 结构整理

- 原先单体的设置弹窗主体拆分为 8 个页面组件、共享行/分组/搜索/导航组件与 11 个领域 composable，删除旧的 `SettingDialogBody.vue` 与 `SettingDialogBody.scss`。
- 设置搜索、快捷键弹窗、音频输出、网易云、AcoustID、指纹库、维护操作等逻辑分别收口，页面只负责展示与绑定。

## English

This release rebuilds the settings window's navigation, search and page layout. Setting semantics and storage formats are unchanged.

### Category navigation and search

- The settings window now uses a left category rail, a top search field and a right content area, with eight pages: Common, General, Player, Shortcuts, Library, Analysis & Fingerprint, Integrations & Services, and Advanced & Maintenance.
- A new Common page pins frequently used settings and keeps the five most recently changed entries; each entry jumps directly to its setting.
- Search covers setting names, descriptions and Chinese/English aliases. Results keep their page and group breadcrumbs, and clicking one jumps straight to the target card.

### Pages and visual alignment

- Every settings page now uses the same two-column card grid; single-control rows place the label on the left and the control on the right, with optically centered checkboxes and radio dots.
- Page titles, group headings, card labels, descriptions, control edges and footer actions share the same visual columns. The search page, danger-action cards and developer-maintenance cards follow the same grid.
- Fixed mid-word breaks and awkward wrapping in narrow hint columns; playlist removal, listening cache and curated-artist hints now use full-width stacked rows.
- Jumping from the Common page or search results now flashes the target card with the existing `flashing-border` effect (three 0.5-second pulses, cleared after 1.5 seconds) instead of leaving a static blue fill.

### Structure

- The monolithic settings body is split into eight page components, shared row/group/search/navigation components and eleven domain composables. The old `SettingDialogBody.vue` and `SettingDialogBody.scss` are removed.
- Settings search, shortcut dialogs, audio output, Netease, AcoustID, fingerprint library and maintenance actions now live in their own composables; pages only render and bind.
